title: CA-471's completeness gate silently skips the LAST lens: `while IFS= read -r _lens; do ... done < "$_manifest"` drops a final line with no trailing newline, and lenses-run.txt is the one manifest in this codebase written by an LLM agent via Write (skills/code-audit/SKILL.md:78) rather than machine-generated. A round missing lens-L11.jsonl whose manifest ends `L11` unterminated records round_type=full and can converge -- the exact pass-7 failure the gate was filed to prevent. Secondary: a CRLF manifest fails ^L[0-9]+$ on every line and disables the gate wholesale. Fix: `|| [[ -n "$_lens" ]]` on the read plus a CR strip before the regex

CA-471's pass-directory resolution silently keeps the LAST of several date-suffixed pass-${round_num}_* glob matches with no diagnostic. A re-run across a date boundary or a hand-copied scratch dir yields two matches: if the newest lacks lens JSONL the gate fires spuriously and downgrades a complete round to permanently non-convergent partial; if the newest is stale but holds JSONL the gate passes VACUOUSLY for the round that actually ran. The C-4 carve-out at :4445 tolerates a MISSING directory and says nothing about an AMBIGUOUS one. Fix: count matches, warn naming all of them when >1, select by mtime or refuse

RESIDUAL OF THE CA-440 FIX: the hook-spawned auditor and the skill's own post-wave QC pass write into ONE qc-shard-NN.md namespace keyed on DIFFERENT quantities -- hooks.json:117 and SKILL.md:81-83 key NN on the lowest TICKET NUMBER, SKILL.md:101 keys it on the SHARD INDEX ({i+1:02d}), SKILL.md:97 on the ticket number again -- and SKILL.md:103 merges both via one qc-shard-*.md glob. Deterministic in the common case: implementers covering T01-T09 leave qc-shard-01/04/07.md, then the skill's own pass writes qc-shard-01.md and destroys the hook shard's FAIL verdicts silently. Same harm CA-440 was rated P1 for, at reduced blast radius. Fix: disjoint namespaces (qc-shard-hook-{ticket}.md vs qc-shard-pass-{i}.md) plus a widened merge glob

A state lockdir with NO pidfile is never reclaimed on the mkdir branch and permanently bricks that initiative's lock. Both reclaim paths live inside `if [[ -f "$pidfile" ]]` (:1348), so a lockdir without one falls straight to _lock_retry_or_die every iteration, exhausts the ~100-try/10s budget and dies, forever. Reachable via (a) crash/kill -9 in the window between mkdir succeeding (:1343) and `echo $$ > "$pidfile"` (:1404) -- traps are not installed until :1425 so even a clean INT there orphans it; (b) that write failing silently, since :1404 ends `2>/dev/null || true` (EROFS/ENOSPC/quota). mkdir is the macOS branch and CLAUDE.md names macOS the primary dev platform, so every edm-state mutation including the Stop/PreCompact checkpoint hooks dies until a human rm -rf's it. Tell: the invalid-PID messages already print '${holder_pid:-missing}' at :1375/:1377/:1379, a label the -f guard makes unreachable. Fix: hoist the age-gated reclaim out of the -f branch and make the :1404 write failure fatal

INTRODUCED BY THE CA-447 FIX: the new first-stage trap `trap 'rm -f "$ATTR_PATTERN_FILE"' EXIT INT TERM HUP` is one body on all four signals with no exit -- the exact CA-446 shape closed twelve lines below it at :149-152, and a direct contradiction of the contract bin/edm-state:687-691 states file-wide. A signal in the covered window (the second mktemp at :144) cleans up and RESUMES, so this binary -- which runs on every git commit via the PreToolUse hook -- swallows the operator's Ctrl-C. Fix: split into the canonical four-arm EXIT / INT+exit 130 / TERM+exit 143 / HUP+exit 129 form

UNSWEPT SITE of the just-closed CA-446/CA-447 class: `trap 'rm -f "${tmp:-}"' RETURN EXIT INT TERM` is one body on all signals with no exit (CA-446's cleanup-then-resume shape) AND omits HUP entirely (the half CA-447 added everywhere else in bin/). evals/*.sh is inside both findings' declared scope; this file was simply never visited by either sweep. Fix: the same four-arm split, plus HUP

The eval's INNER per-phase timeout budget and the OUTER CI job timeout are uncoupled and undocumented, and the inner budget already consumes 90% of the outer. eval:nightly sets timeout: 150m (9000s); run-eval.sh runs exactly three phases (:500/:533/:571) at PHASE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=2700 each plus a 60s auth probe = 8160s = 136m, before npm install, provisioning, scoring and comparison. When the outer timeout wins, GitLab kills the job and the trailing script steps -- score-artifacts.sh, edm-compare-eval, and CA-452's own 'partial always fails the job' step at :771-775 -- never run, bypassing the partial-run handshake in exactly the case it exists for. CA-444 validated the knob's TYPE but left it unbounded above: EDM_EVAL_PHASE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3600 passes validation and makes 3x3600=180m > 150m, i.e. the phase timeout becomes dead wiring. Neither file references the other. Fix: derive one from the other (refuse at startup when 3*PHASE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS+120 exceeds CI_JOB_TIMEOUT) and comment the arithmetic at both sites

CA-442 VERIFIED FIXED and verified NOT to reintroduce CA-141 (with_state_lock's own cleanup at :1425/:1455 targets _STATE_LOCKDIR at the DESTINATION path, which no longer exists after the rollback rename, so no contender's live lockdir can be deleted). Recorded residual, not re-filed: the justifying comment at :3640-3641 cites 'the flock file (fd 200) is still held until this body returns', which is true only on the flock branch -- on the mkdir branch (macOS) the lockdir IS the primitive, so this rm releases the lock before the body returns. Traced as benign (only rmdir follows and cmd_migrate_path dies immediately after, so nothing mutates state unprotected). Same comment/branch mismatch at the forward body :3613. Comment correctness -> CA-439's open class

INVESTIGATED AND DISMISSED, recorded so a later round does not re-derive it: debt_recheck_p0 and debt_recheck_p1 reach `[[ -eq ]]` at :3125 without to_int, three lines after CA-428's coercion sweep, which looks like a missed sibling. It is not -- _audit_ledger_breakdown (:1565-1578) derives both via `| length`, so they are non-negative integers by construction, and a malformed ledger makes jq fail so the && at :3122 short-circuits and the debt override is skipped fail-safe. Not a live instance of CA-157's arithmetic-context class

CONFIRMING CA-447 (open), not re-filing: _harness.sh:85, _harness.sh:114 and harness-smoke.sh:264 still carry the single-body `EXIT INT TERM HUP` trap with no exit that CA-447 named, while the bin/ half of that finding did land. Also a test-only code path per the False Alarm Filter

CA-445 VERIFIED FIXED (path emitted last so read's final variable absorbs the remainder; the other three fields -- key, sha-256 hex, ISO-8601 UTC -- provably cannot contain a space). Accepted residuals recorded so they are not re-derived: a recorded path containing a NEWLINE still mis-splits across two loop iterations, and IFS=' ' strips a trailing space from the final field. Both are pathological path shapes outside the fix's stated contract

Recorded as MECHANISM, not filed separately: the lockdir created at :1343 has no trap covering it until :1425, so a signal in that window orphans it. This is the window that makes the missing-pidfile finding above reachable rather than an independent trap-coverage gap -- fixing that finding's reclaim path makes this window self-healing, and filing both would double-count one defect

ROUND-9 COVERAGE CAVEAT (CA-130's class, recurring): this lens was delivered with NEITHER Write NOR Bash in its runtime tool set. Consequences specific to this POST-REMEDIATION round: (i) git log/diff over the designated 833a06d..HEAD range could not be run, so every Priority-1 remediation verdict is derived from reading source at HEAD rather than from the diffs -- I cannot attest to what a fix commit touched outside the sites I read; (ii) the smoke suite could not be executed and no finding was reproduced dynamically (the missing-pidfile window and the read-drops-last-line behaviour are asserted from bash semantics, not observed); (iii) the markdown report and this JSONL were returned inline in the final message instead of written to pass-9_2026-08-16/. CA-130 carries a do-not-re-file disposition; logged here as a round-9 recurrence and as the confidence qualifier on the verification table
